name: cme-content-worker
description: Cruise Made Easy Content Generation and Management System on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm run build:templates && vite build && npm run build:upload-assets
scripts.build:worker: npm run update-version && npm run build:templates && wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.check: tsc && npm run build && wrangler deploy --env="" --dry-run
scripts.dev: echo 'DEPRECATED: Use background sessions - npm run dev:frontend (bg) + npm run dev:worker (bg)'
scripts.dev:start: echo 'DEPRECATED: Use background sessions via Claude Bash tool'
scripts.dev:restart: echo 'DEPRECATED: Kill sessions and restart via Claude Bash tool'
scripts.dev:bg: echo 'Background session development mode - use Claude Bash tool with run_in_background: true for both npm run dev:frontend and npm run dev:worker'
scripts.dev:bg-status: echo 'Sessions: Vite (localhost:5174 - React dev with HMR) + Worker (localhost:8787 - Production-like with built React)' && lsof -i:5174 -i:8787 | grep LISTEN
scripts.dev:bg-stop: pkill -f 'wrangler dev' && pkill -f vite && echo 'Background development sessions stopped'
